title: Triage & Roadmap 1:1 playbook — API / Console / Dedicated / Private
content:
Quick notes for weekly 1:1 with Marco (eng lead) — lightweight, action-oriented. Use as my speaking guide and live capture for follow-ups.

Context:
- Focus areas this week: API latency regression after load test, Console rollout for per-route tracing, Dedicated capacity autoscaler tuning, Private deployment onboarding checklist for PharmaPoC.
- Goal for meeting: align on immediate mitigations, decide canary plan for console change, confirm owners for Dedicated autoscaler tickets, and surface any blockers for Private infra validation.

Top metrics to call out (have numbers ready):
- API p99 latency (last 7d): 430ms (target 350ms) — spike coincides with increased burst traffic on /v1/chat-stream.
- Error rate (5xx) for same endpoint: 0.14% (baseline 0.03%).
- Avg cost per 1k tokens served (hosted): $0.92 — trending up week-over-week due to smaller batch sizes.
- Dedicated cluster utilization: 78% (one pool at 95% during peak).
- Console feature flag adoption for tracing: 12% of routes in org sandbox.

Incidents / recent signals to surface:
- Late Friday: brief degradation, root cause appears to be suboptimal batching when token distribution shifts. Ticket INF-4821 (assigned to @lina) with initial BLAME: batching heuristic.
- Customer report (acct: graybox-ai) about inconsistent streaming chunks when routed to smaller VMs. Possible KV cache miss pattern. Raised GH PR 1284 that includes a conservative fallback for cache warmup.

Agenda (30 min):
- 0-5m quick status: how are you? blockers you want me to know about (psych safety check).
- 5-12m metrics walk — p99 + errors + cost. Confirm we agree on priority.
- 12-20m mitigation options for latency regression (short, med, long):
   * Short: temporarily raise batch size min threshold for affected routes; enable aggressive KV prewarm for high-QPS prefixes. (owner: Marco)
   * Medium: tune kernel selection fallback to prefer lower latency kernels for sequence len > 1024 (owner: serving-runtime).
   * Long: scheduling rewrite to colocate hot prefixes with warm KV cache (needs infra design).
- 20-25m Console rollout decision: proceed with canary + tighter observability or pause? Discuss rollback plan and who approves.
- 25-30m Actions + owners + next check-in (timing)

Questions I want answered or clarified:
- Is the batching heuristic change from INF-4821 safe to ship to prod canary tonight? Quick risk assessment from Marco.
- If we open a short-term global override to force slightly larger batches, can we bound memory and tail latency impact? (SRE ask)
- For Console tracing rollout: can we add per-route sampling instead of all-or-nothing? Who needs to sign off for privacy review?
- Dedicated autoscaler: current cooldown is 10m — should we shorten to 3m for predictable bursts? Cost vs SLA tradeoffs — need decision.
- Private onboarding: which infra checklist items are still manual and can we automate before next customer demo? (list the top 3)

Possible agenda pivots (if Marco brings up product asks):
- API contract tweak request from partner team: defer or triage? Need quick impact estimate.
- A/B rollout for new quantization profile — does it belong in Optimize or Dedicated config?

Decisions needed in this meeting (explicit):
- Approve emergency canary for batching heuristic tonight? (yes/no)
- Approve Console tracing canary scope: 10% of routes vs 5% (pick one).
- Autoscaler cooldown: 10m -> 3m for burst pools? (approve to run experiment)

Action items to capture (write-down during meeting):
- (Marco) Run a 2-hour canary in us-west with INF-4821 patch; monitor p99 and error rate every 15m. Due: tonight EOD.
- (Lina) Add a causal tag to INF-4821 linking to memory regression dashboard; add playbook steps for rollback. Due: +24h.
- (Maya) Draft an email to Graybox-AI with status + mitigations and expected ETA. Due: +3h.
- (SRE lead) Implement temporary override to set min_batch_size=128 for /v1/chat-stream for 12 hours. Due: within 2h if approved.
- (Platform) Prototype per-route sampling toggle in Console behind feature flag (flag: console.per_route_sample). Due: 2 sprints for baseline feature, immediate canary toggle for demo.
- (Marco) Evaluate Dedicated autoscaler change as experiment; write short A/B plan and expected cost delta. Due: next Wed.

Notes-to-self (capture wording during meeting):
- Push Marco for clear rollback criteria: p99 > 600ms or error rate > 0.5% -> abort.
- Ask Lina for exact log query to track KV cache miss pattern; add to incident runbook.
- If canary shows improvement but memory climbs, propose we throttle tracing sample or pause console rollout.

Open risks and unknowns:
- Potential memory spike from larger batches on small-VM fleet leading to OOMs — need safety net.
- Private customer demo depends on one manual cert step in onboarding script — automation effort might slip.
- Cost alarms not tuned — risk of overprovisioning during autoscaler experiment.

Follow-ups I will do after the meeting:
- Update product roadmap tracker with decision outcome and new due dates (tracker: ROADMAP-2025-Q1).
- Add a short note to the weekly exec update if we flip the canary to mitigate customer concerns.
- Schedule a 30m deep-dive next week with serving-runtime + SRE to design kernel fallback improvements.

Meeting prep checklist (what I need to have open):
- Dashboard: prod-latency -> p50/p95/p99 + error breakdown by route (open in two tabs).
- INF-4821 ticket and current patch diff (GH PR 1284).
- Console feature flag matrix and privacy checklist (Confluence).
- Dedicated pool utilization sheet (link local).
- Quick words to say: "Prioritize customer availability over cost for the next 36h; we can tighten later." Keep this short and empathetic.

Tone notes: keep the convo collaborative, not accusatory. Ask "what do you need from me" at the end. Capture decisions live and call out blockers explicitly.

--- scratch area (during meeting) ---
[capture snippets here]
- Marco: "ok to canary, watch memory"
- Lina: "adding log query now -> logql: sum by(route) (rate(kv_cache_miss[5m]))"
- Action added: Marco -> canary started 2025-01-18 20:16 PST (monitoring link: https://grafana.redwood/d/abc123/canary).

End of notes.
